role: academic research analyst: nonlinear causal structure and multi-factor mechanism
search_scope: Primary papers and author repositories; 2024-2026 developments plus mature baseline. No models fitted, dependencies installed or prior test reopened.

sources.title: Causal-learn: Causal Discovery in Python
sources.fit: First small-scale structure baseline: PC-stable plus kernel CI under causal sufficiency; FCI plus kernel CI for latent-confounding equivalence-class output. Low-dimensional event-level variables fit better than high-dimensional waveform graph learning.
sources.limits: FCI requires causal Markov/faithfulness, valid CI tests and appropriate independent rows. It outputs a PAG, not guaranteed exact DAG, nor a causal effect or proof that hidden confounding is absent. KCI is cubic in row count. Do not treat repeated events as independent CI-test rows.
sources.background_knowledge_source_audit: Tag0.1.4.8 FCI.py lines245-267 turns a forbidden X->Y relation on an existing adjacency into the opposite directed edge with a tail. Encoding merely 'later Y cannot cause earlier A' by forbid(Y,A) would impose A->Y and can erase latent-confounding-compatible endpoints. Use no BK initially; keep temporal knowledge separate until endpoint semantics are validated. This is an input-semantics limitation, not a performance-failure claim.
sources.decision: Recommended baseline pilot; no adoption claim. Pin exact tag if later installed. Report CPDAG/PAG endpoints rather than coercing all edges to DAG.

sources.title: Score matching through the roof: linear, nonlinear, and latent variables causal discovery
sources.maintenance: Archived2025-03-12; research reproduction repository,2 visible commits; README usesPython3.12.5.
sources.license: Repository badgeMIT-0; inspected score_independence.py SPDX saysMIT. Preserve both if later reusing, no source copied here.
sources.assumptions: Score/Hessian criteria use positive differentiable density. Stronger directed-edge identification assumes C3 additive observed and latent mechanisms, independent positive-density noise, and non-Gaussian noise for linear arguments; see Section2, Proposition1 and Assumption1.
sources.fit: Interesting recent research comparator for smooth continuous SCM diagnostic controls; weaker linear/nonlinear restrictions than original SCORE.
sources.task_mismatch_inference: Current cumulativeY has atoms at0 and sometimesT, with Bernoulli/Beta generation and quantized10s outcomes. These do not directly satisfy the stated positive smooth continuous-density additive-noise model. Adding jitter or discarding zeros would alter the data/problem, not establish assumptions.
sources.decision: Reserve, not first main method on current bounded zero-massY. Could compare only in a separately declared smooth-ANM diagnostic, not claim full task coverage.

sources.title: Ordering-Based Causal Discovery for Linear and Nonlinear Relations
sources.maintenance: 7visiblecommits; precise latestdate not verified. Research repository usesR-dependentcdt/CAM pruning, increasing adaptation cost.
sources.assumptions: Section3.1 PDFpage3 assumes no unobservable confounder and Gaussian additive independent noise. Assumption1 PDFpage4 gives sufficient identifiability via non-decreasing noise variance or sufficiently strong effects. Nonlinear/linear mixture does not remove these conditions.
sources.fit: Mixed linear/nonlinear smooth-ANM comparator; parent score relates to derivative-based effect magnitude under its assumptions.
sources.decision: Not first taskbaseline: latentconfounding and bounded zero-massY conflict with core assumptions; parent score is not automatically causal factor contribution for our data.

sources.title: DAGMA: Learning DAGs via M-matrices and a Log-Determinant Acyclicity Characterization
sources.maintenance: 109visiblecommits; exact latestdate not verified. Numpy/scipy/igraph and nonlinear torch-based model ecosystem; no install performed.
sources.fit: Mature differentiable acyclicity optimizer supporting linear/nonlinear continuous score models and binary logistic models.
sources.limits: Acyclicity constraint ensures a DAG-shaped fitted structure, not uniqueness/causal identifiability under arbitrary hidden confounding. Separate binary support does not automatically provide a correct zero-inflated bounded continuous likelihood.
sources.decision: Reserve causal-sufficient comparator; not selected solely for producing a complete directed graph.

sources.title: FoundCause: Causal Discovery with Latent Confounders from Observational Data
sources.publication: arXiv2606.17516v1,2026-06-16; no peer-reviewed venue independently verified
sources.maintenance: Archived2026-06-17 for exact reproduction; README says PRsnotaccepted. v1.0releaseJune17,commitbf21a29.
sources.cost: RepositoryREADME: pretrainedcheckpoint about1.6GB/139Mparameters; torch and schedulefree among dependencies; CPUoptionavailable. Not downloaded or run.
sources.fit: Recent amortized transformer trained on syntheticSCMs, predicts directed edges and hidden-confounder scores. Research benchmark claims include latentconfounding, so worth a later task-matched comparison.
sources.limits: Repository lists training2-50variables,100-600samples, observational-only input. Predicted confounder scores are learned-pattern predictions rather than a proof of latent identification or removal; benefit on our zero-mass, repeated-user data untested.
sources.decision: Latest reserve, not initial4-variablepilot priority because adaptation and checkpoint cost exceed established FCI baseline.

sources.title: Assessing the Overall and Partial Causal Well-Specification of Nonlinear Additive Noise Models
sources.license: NoLICENSEfile or reuse license verified at repository entrance; no code copied
sources.maintenance: 185visiblecommits; exactlatestdate not verified. R software usesFOCI andxgboost; authorREADME notes FOCI with ties can be nondeterministic and ignoreRseeds.
sources.fit: Methodological reference for testing whether nonlinear/additive causal modeling is well specified, rather than accepting every fitted graph as mechanism evidence.
sources.decision: Use theoretical guidance, reserve implementation pending license and bounded/tied-outcome applicability; do not make it an initial dependency.

local_data_findings.finding: Existing user randomu affectsYbut not treatment assignment. Therefore previous repeated-user study did not evaluateu as unmeasured common cause ofAandY. Hidden-outcome heterogeneity alone is not treatment-outcome confounding.
local_data_findings.needs_new_mechanism: For a genuine latent-confounding challenge, explicitly putHinto bothAassignment andYresponseSCM; graph oracle must use latentprojection/equivalence class. Existing test remains spent and unchanged.

proposed_one_question: Can a low-dimensional nonlinear structure analysis separate incentive-response links, pretreatment allocation bias, null factors and latent-compatible ambiguity, before interpreting the continuous incentive curve?

minimal_pilot.data: New explicitSCM cohorts, independentuser seeds distinct from oldpilot. Mechanisms: randomizedA; observed nonlinearL/Uconfounding; A-null-response; hiddenH->AandH->Y. RetainboundedYzero/fullatoms. SmoothANM diagnostics, if used, are a separate applicability control.
minimal_pilot.independence_unit: GraphCI learning initiallyone predetermined event peruser. Use allusers/allrespondersandnonresponders forcurveanalysis. Repeated-event effect analysis groups byuser; ordinaryCItestsare not made independent merelybyclusterbootstrap.
minimal_pilot.methods: FCI+KCI without strongBK as core latent-compatible baseline; PCstable+KCI as causallysufficient comparison; existing declaredgraph/parent-screen as transparent reference. No new maturemethod called ourinnovation.
minimal_pilot.prior_knowledge: Record temporal tiers independently. Do not feed forbiddenreverseedge intoFCIas if it meantonlytimeorder; verify endpoint semantics first. Do not force unresolvedPAGendpointstoarrows to inflategraphaccuracy.
minimal_pilot.metrics: Skeletonprecision/recall,arrowhead/tailprecisionagainstcorrectCPDAG/PAGoracle,notrawDAGSHDforlatentPAG; null-factorfalseedges; user-subsamplestability; outputambiguityandcoverage; downstreamcurvebiasonlywhenadjustmentidentified. A graphcan remain unidentifiable withfourvariables.
minimal_pilot.stop: Smallfixeddevelopmentdesign first; then freezeone justifiedvariant and newheldoutmechanism evaluation. Failure toidentify is a researchfinding, not permission to reuse oldtest or deletezeroresponses.

overall_recommendation: Start causal-learn nonlinearCI structurepilot plus explicitSCM and retainedcontinuousDR. Recentmethods broaden the survey, but none removes missinginput/identifiability requirements. Structurediscovery diagnoses plausiblepaths and uncertainty; factor-specific interventions/effect-modification curves remain separate estimands.
